decision.rationale: The only new measurement evidence ranks components; it does not isolate a new algorithm, source boundary or selected numerical contract that earlier held research left unanswered. Main already owns a fresh serial-then-subgroup QSA comparison. Starting a broader GDN, MoE or generic SYCL survey now would repeat indexed work or report a design question Main has not selected.

candidate_assessments.current_evidence: The current 78,453-token diagnostic attributes 8.032 s across 1,476 recurrence commands; it is whole-process command time, not a clean speed result or critical-path split. The current output16-only candidate remains uncompiled and GPU-unrun.

prior_work.status: Held source-literature comparison already covers chunked GDN/WY, recurrence scans, local-state tiling, non-LLM IIR and systolic dataflow; retrieval requires a concrete Main-owned GDN design decision.
Covers Qwen4-Exp model-path GDN/HC/PLE order and a related vLLM family analogy; it does not pin the target model/backend route or qualify component timing/adoption.

candidate_assessments.next_gate: After the QSA pair, Main pins a specific GDN recurrence/dataflow change and its SGLang/vLLM serving-path contract; retrieve the matching R943 sections first and request new work only for a demonstrated gap.

execution_boundary.active_main_work: Main-owned fresh four-request serial QSA cohort followed by four-request subgroup cohort; do not duplicate or dispatch around it.
execution_boundary.measurement_limits: The profile is a collector-enabled diagnostic; command totals overlap and are not utilization, physical traffic, occupancy or critical-path attribution. The 667.2 tok/s diagnostic sample does not replace the clean cohort.
execution_boundary.future_source_rules: Any later research must name a finite unanswered question, pin exact source/revision and primary references, compare alternatives and counterevidence, verify provenance and licenses, and remain source-analysis only. Do not use XeStrata or copy/adapt source; Main retains all build, test, GPU and profiler work.
